rules: Each assessment references exactly one snapshot_id.
Issued assessments are immutable and are never deleted.
Changed evaluations require a new assessment_id and archival of the prior assessment.
The same snapshot_id and identical Evidence Package must reproduce the same assessment; any divergence requires a recorded cause.
Every recommendation requires quantitative justification and an Evidence Reference.
Track B may request registration but does not modify this registry.
Assessment generation requires snapshot registration, evidence package availability, and registry validation pass.
If trigger conditions are incomplete, Track B remains WAITING FOR SNAPSHOT.
